CVC Report: Over 70,000 Corruption Complaints Against Govt Departments

The Central Vigilance Commission's (CVC) annual report indicates a significant number of corruption complaints filed against government departments. The report details 70,584 complaints received, with banks and railways identified as the sectors with the highest number of corruption cases. This figure highlights ongoing challenges with integrity within public sector organizations, despite government claims.
